fields.title: 2. Post-Quarter Buybacks — Back-Calculated from Source Filings
fields.md:
The 10-Q body does not state the October repurchase amount (source: [10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526452412/brka-20260930.htm)). Instead, the decline in share count can be measured from two figures in the filings:
- Class A-equivalent shares at 2026-09-30: 1,418,900 = 481,584 Class A + 1,405,974,025 Class B ÷ 1,500 (formula, [10-Q common stock note R27](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526452412/R27.htm)).
- Cover page at 2026-10-28: 480,476 Class A · 1,403,805,594 Class B → 1,416,346 Class A-equivalent shares (formula 480,476 + 1,403,805,594 ÷ 1,500, [10-Q cover page](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526452412/brka-20260930.htm)).
- The decline of 2,554 Class A-equivalent shares = about 3.83 million Class B-equivalent shares (formula 2,553.6 × 1,500). Because A→B conversion does not change the Class A-equivalent count, the decline is attributable to buybacks (judgment, based on the formula).
- Multiplying by the October Class B closing price range of $500.50 (10/1) to $548.56 (10/26) ([stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/brk.b/history/)) gives **$1.92 billion to $2.10 billion** (estimate, formula 3,830,406 × 500.50 / × 548.56). This is consistent with Round 1's reported figure of 'about $2 billion' — replaced with a range verifiable from the filings, closing the open item. The confirmed amount will be in the 4Q26 10-K repurchase table (T2).
- Reference: 9M26 buybacks of $14.409 billion exactly equal the increase in treasury stock at cost within equity (93,348 − 78,939 = 14,409, formula, [10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526452412/brka-20260930.htm)). Shares acquired in 9M: 5,047 Class A · 21,414,614 Class B → 19,323 Class A-equivalent shares (formula), average price per Class B-equivalent share of about $497 (formula 14,409 ÷ (19,323 × 1,500)).
- Reference figures for C-2027-2 (2027 buybacks of $20 billion) and R4 (annual above $30 billion): about $16.3 billion to $16.5 billion for January–October 2026 (formula 144.1 + 19.2~21.0, estimate). R4 looks only at the annual value for the assessment year — pending.
